title: 1 Overview
summary: Introduces the report's coverage of 2023 operations across monetary policy, financial stability, supervision, payment systems, and consumer affairs.

title: 2 Monetary Policy and Economic Developments
summary: Presents the Federal Reserve's monetary policy actions and economic developments in 2023, including summaries of the semiannual policy reports.

sub_nodes.title: 2.1 March 2024 Summary
sub_nodes.summary: Highlights inflation easing, labor market conditions, and the Fed’s stance on interest rates and balance‑sheet reduction as of March 2024.

sub_nodes.title: 2.2 June 2023 Summary
sub_nodes.summary: Summarizes inflation moderation, tight labor market, GDP growth, and continued interest‑rate hikes and securities‑holdings reductions in mid‑2023.

title: 3 Financial Stability
summary: Describes the Fed’s monitoring of financial system risks, coordination with domestic and international partners, and key activities in 2023.

sub_nodes.title: 3.1 Monitoring Financial Vulnerabilities
sub_nodes.summary: Outlines the quarterly assessment of four core vulnerabilities—asset valuations, borrowing, leverage, and funding risk.

title: 4 Supervision and Regulation
summary: Details the Fed’s supervisory and regulatory responsibilities, including oversight of banks, holding companies, and financial market utilities.

sub_nodes.title: 4.1 Supervised and Regulated Institutions
sub_nodes.summary: Provides data on the types and numbers of banks, holding companies, and other entities supervised by the Fed.

sub_nodes.title: 4.2 Financial Market Utilities
sub_nodes.summary: Explains the Fed’s supervision of designated financial market utilities and related risk‑management standards.

sub_nodes.title: 4.3 Specialized Examinations
sub_nodes.summary: Covers the Fed’s targeted examinations of institutions on capital planning, stress testing, cybersecurity, and other specialized areas.

sub_nodes.title: 4.4 Enforcement Actions
sub_nodes.summary: Reports 63 formal and 99 informal Federal Reserve enforcement actions in 2023, including civil penalties and public disclosure of orders.

sub_nodes.title: 4.5 Financial Disclosures by State Member Banks
sub_nodes.summary: Describes the requirement for state member banks to file SEC‑style financial disclosures and notes one bank complied in 2023.

sub_nodes.title: 4.6 Internal Appeals of Material Supervisory Determinations
sub_nodes.summary: Outlines the two‑level intra‑agency appeal process for material supervisory determinations and notes one MSD appeal received in 2023.

sub_nodes.title: 4.7 Assessments for Supervision and Regulation
sub_nodes.summary: Details assessments collected from large banking entities, amounting to $771 million transferred to the Treasury in 2023.

sub_nodes.title: 4.8 Training and Technical Assistance
sub_nodes.summary: Summarizes domestic and international training programs, including 20 seminars for foreign supervisors and outreach to minority‑owned institutions.

sub_nodes.title: 4.9 Support for Minority‑Owned Depository Institutions
sub_nodes.summary: Describes the Partnership for Progress program, outreach events, and the 2023 MDI portfolio of 16 state member banks.

sub_nodes.title: 4.10 International Engagement
sub_nodes.summary: Highlights participation in the Financial Stability Board, Basel Committee, CPMI, and IAIS, including publications and policy contributions.

sub_nodes.title: 4.11 Bank Secrecy Act and Anti‑Money Laundering Compliance
sub_nodes.summary: Discusses the Federal Reserve’s role in BSA/AML examinations, contributions to the AML Act implementation, and international sanctions coordination.

sub_nodes.title: 4.12 Regulatory Reports
sub_nodes.summary: Covers revisions to FR Y‑7Q, FR Y‑9C, FR Y‑14, FR Y‑12/A reporting forms and FFIEC reporting updates for 2023.

sub_nodes.title: 4.13 Regulatory Developments
sub_nodes.summary: Lists 2023 rulemakings, guidance, and policy statements issued jointly or by the Fed, spanning crypto‑asset risk, LIBOR transition, and capital requirements.

title: 5 Payment System and Reserve Bank Oversight
summary: Describes the Federal Reserve’s payment services, FedNow launch, cost recovery, currency operations, fiscal agency duties, and research activities in 2023.

sub_nodes.title: 5.1 Overview of Payment Services
sub_nodes.summary: Introduces key functions such as payment services, currency distribution, fiscal agency roles, and Reserve Bank oversight.

sub_nodes.title: 5.2 Priced Services Cost Recovery
sub_nodes.summary: Reports full cost recovery of priced services in 2023, with a 106.7 % recovery rate and a $40.1 million net income.

sub_nodes.title: 5.3 Service Activity Data
sub_nodes.summary: Provides 2023 activity statistics for commercial checks, ACH, Fedwire funds, national settlement, and securities transfers.

sub_nodes.title: 5.4 FedNow Service
sub_nodes.summary: Describes the instant‑payment service launched in July 2023, its early adoption by over 300 institutions, and projected growth.

sub_nodes.title: 5.5 Fedwire Funds and National Settlement Services
sub_nodes.summary: Details cost recovery, transaction volumes, and average daily values for Fedwire funds and the National Settlement Service.

sub_nodes.title: 5.6 Fedwire Securities Service
sub_nodes.summary: Covers inclusion of Treasury securities in the priced component, cost recovery at 122.3 %, and growth in transfer volumes.

sub_nodes.title: 5.7 FedLine Solutions
sub_nodes.summary: Lists six FedLine connectivity solutions and recent migration away from legacy products.

sub_nodes.title: 5.8 Intraday Credit
sub_nodes.summary: Explains daylight overdraft facilities, low usage levels, and fee policy under the ample‑reserves regime.

sub_nodes.title: 5.9 Currency and Coin
sub_nodes.summary: Summarizes distribution of notes and coins, next‑generation banknote program, and currency education outreach.

sub_nodes.title: 5.10 Fiscal Agency and Government Depository Services
sub_nodes.summary: Describes the Reserve Banks’ role as Treasury fiscal agent, expense breakdown, and payment services for the government.

sub_nodes.title: 5.11 Infrastructure and Technology Services
sub_nodes.summary: Details cloud migration, system modernization, and support services provided to the Treasury and other entities.

sub_nodes.title: 5.12 Payment System Research and Regulation
sub_nodes.summary: Highlights research on payment innovations, digital assets, and the Board’s regulatory responsibilities for the payment system.

sub_nodes.title: 5.13 Other Improvements and Efforts
sub_nodes.summary: Discusses FedNow implementation, technology modernization, cybersecurity, and facility renovation projects.

sub_nodes.title: 5.14 Oversight of Federal Reserve Banks
sub_nodes.summary: Describes the Board's audit, internal‑control assessments, and COSO‑based oversight of the Reserve Banks.

sub_nodes.title: 5.15 Financial Statements and Audits
sub_nodes.summary: Details KPMG’s audit of combined and individual financial statements, LLC audits, and auditor‑independence safeguards.

sub_nodes.title: 5.16 System Open Market Account (SOMA) Holdings
sub_nodes.summary: Presents SOMA asset composition, income, expense tables and related lending program balances.

sub_nodes.title: 5.17 Priced Services Pro Forma Financial Statements
sub_nodes.summary: Provides balance‑sheet and income‑statement pro forma data for Federal Reserve priced services and related notes.

title: 6 Consumer and Community Affairs
summary: Covers the Board’s consumer protection, community development, supervision, research, and outreach activities.

sub_nodes.title: 6.1 Consumer Compliance Supervision
sub_nodes.summary: Outlines supervision of state member banks for compliance with consumer protection laws and the CRA.

sub_nodes.title: 6.2 Community Reinvestment Act Evaluation
sub_nodes.summary: Summarizes CRA performance examinations, ratings, and the 2023 final rule modernizing CRA regulations.

sub_nodes.title: 6.3 Fair Lending and UDAP Enforcement
sub_nodes.summary: Describes enforcement actions, DOJ referrals, and tools used to address fair‑lending and deceptive‑practice violations.

sub_nodes.title: 6.4 Mergers and Acquisitions Review
sub_nodes.summary: Explains Board’s criteria and processes for evaluating bank merger and acquisition applications.

sub_nodes.title: 6.5 Coordination with Other Agencies
sub_nodes.summary: Details inter‑agency coordination with the CFPB, OCC, FDIC, NCUA, and others on supervisory matters.

sub_nodes.title: 6.6 Outreach and Publications
sub_nodes.summary: Highlights public outreach, Consumer Compliance Outlook issues, webinars, and other communication efforts.

sub_nodes.title: 6.7 Examiner Training and Professional Development
sub_nodes.summary: Describes the Consumer Compliance Examiner Commissioning Program, rapid‑response sessions, and continuing education.

sub_nodes.title: 6.8 Consumer Complaints and Investigations
sub_nodes.summary: Provides statistics on complaints received, processing by the Federal Reserve Consumer Help unit, and resolution outcomes.

sub_nodes.title: 6.9 Regulatory Updates and Annual Indexing
sub_nodes.summary: Covers updates to exemption thresholds for Regulation Z, Regulation M, higher‑priced‑mortgage appraisal rules, and CRA asset‑size thresholds.

sub_nodes.title: 6.10 Research, Surveys, and Community Development
sub_nodes.summary: Summarizes SHED survey results, research publications, and community‑development seminar series.

title: 7 Federal Reserve System Organization
summary: Lists key officials, Board members, and division leadership for the Board of Governors and regional banks.

title: 8 Federal Open Market Committee
summary: Describes the composition, members, and alternate members of the Federal Open Market Committee in 2023.

sub_nodes.title: 8.1 Officers
sub_nodes.summary: Lists the officers supporting the Federal Open Market Committee, including the Secretary and Assistant Secretaries.

title: 9 Board of Governors Advisory Councils
summary: Introduces the advisory councils that assist the Board of Governors, with a focus on the Federal Advisory Council.

sub_nodes.title: 9.1 Officers
sub_nodes.summary: Provides the officer roster for the Federal Advisory Council.

title: 10 Community Advisory Council
summary: Describes the Community Advisory Council, its purpose, membership, and meeting schedule.

sub_nodes.title: 10.1 Officers
sub_nodes.summary: Lists the officers and leadership of the Community Advisory Council.

title: 11 Model Validation Council
summary: Explains the purpose of the Model Validation Council and notes that it had no members or meetings in 2023.

title: 12 Federal Reserve Banks and Branches
summary: Outlines the structure of Reserve Banks and their branches, including director classes and governance requirements.

title: 13 Reserve Bank and Branch Leadership
summary: Details the leadership roles (chair, deputy chair, president, first vice‑president) for each Reserve Bank and its branches.

title: 14 Leadership Conferences
summary: Summarizes the conferences of chairs and presidents that coordinate policies and advise the Board of Governors.

sub_nodes.title: 14.1 Conference of Chairs
sub_nodes.summary: Lists the executive committee members of the 2023 Conference of Chairs.

sub_nodes.title: 14.2 Conference of Presidents
sub_nodes.summary: Lists the officers and leadership of the 2023 Conference of Presidents.

title: 15 Conference of First Vice Presidents
summary: Provides the officer roster for the 2023 Conference of First Vice Presidents.

title: 16 Minutes of Federal Open Market Committee Meetings
summary: Provides links and descriptions of the eight regular FOMC meeting minutes published for 2023.

title: 17 Federal Reserve System Audits
summary: Describes the multiple layers of audits and reviews conducted on the Board, Reserve Banks, and the System.

title: 18 Federal Reserve System Budgets
summary: Presents the 2023 budget performance and 2024 budget outlook for the Board of Governors and Reserve Banks.

sub_nodes.title: 18.1 2024 Capital Budgets
sub_nodes.summary: Summary of the Board’s and Reserve Banks’ 2024 capital allocations, emphasizing strategic projects and infrastructure investments.

sub_nodes.title: 18.2 Board of Governors Budgets
sub_nodes.summary: Description of the Board’s budgeting process, growth targets, and alignment with the Strategic Plan 2024‑27.

sub_nodes.title: 18.3 2023 Budget Performance – Board of Governors
sub_nodes.summary: Report on actual 2023 expenses versus budget, including operating and capital spending for the Board.

sub_nodes.title: 18.4 Office of Inspector General (OIG) Budget
sub_nodes.summary: Presentation of the OIG’s 2023 financial results and 2024 operating and capital budget projections.

sub_nodes.title: 18.5 Federal Reserve Banks Budgets
sub_nodes.summary: Explanation of Reserve Banks’ budgeting process, functional‑area allocations, and alignment with system‑wide strategic objectives.

sub_nodes.title: 18.5.1 Reserve Bank Operating Expenses by District and Function
sub_nodes.summary: Tables of 2023‑24 operating expenses and employment by district, functional area, and account classification.

sub_nodes.title: 18.6 Currency Budget
sub_nodes.summary: Details of the Board’s currency reimbursement budget, program‑management expenses, and the Currency Education Program.

title: 19 Record of Policy Actions of the Board of Governors
summary: Compilation of 2023 policy actions, including rules, regulations, and statements, with voting records.

sub_nodes.title: 19.1 Rules and Regulations
sub_nodes.summary: Final rules adopted in 2023 on capital adequacy for bank holding companies and related statutory requirements.

sub_nodes.title: 19.2 Regulation BB (Community Reinvestment)
sub_nodes.summary: Final rule modernizing the Community Reinvestment Act, introducing tiered evaluation and updated geographic framework.

sub_nodes.title: 19.3 Rules of Practice and Procedure
sub_nodes.summary: Final rule enabling electronic communications in administrative hearings and other procedural updates.

sub_nodes.title: 19.4 Policy Statements and Other Actions
sub_nodes.summary: Key 2023 policy statements on credit‑loss allowances, commercial real‑estate loan accommodations, and climate‑related risk management.

title: 20 The Board of Governors and the Government Performance and Results Act – Overview
summary: Describes the Board’s voluntary GPRA compliance, strategic plan, annual performance plan and report.

title: 21 F Litigation
summary: Summarizes 2023 lawsuits and appeals involving the Board, including FOIA actions and administrative‑procedure challenges.

title: 22 Statistical Tables
summary: Appendix of statistical tables presenting historical and 2023 data on the Federal Reserve’s operations, holdings and banking metrics.

sub_nodes.title: 22.1 G.1 – Federal Reserve open‑market transactions, 2023
sub_nodes.summary: Monthly totals of open‑market purchases, sales, exchanges and redemptions of Treasury and agency securities for 2023.

sub_nodes.title: 22.2 G.2 – Federal Reserve Bank holdings of U.S. Treasury and federal agency securities, 2021‑2023
sub_nodes.summary: Year‑end balances of Treasury and agency securities held outright by Reserve Banks, broken out by maturity and type.

sub_nodes.title: 22.3 G.3 – Reserve requirements of depository institutions, December 31 2023
sub_nodes.summary: Required reserve percentages for various liability types of depository institutions as of the end of 2023.

sub_nodes.title: 22.4 G.4 – Banking offices and banks affiliated with bank holding companies, 2022‑2023
sub_nodes.summary: Counts of commercial banks, branches and BHC‑affiliated banks with changes during 2023.

sub_nodes.title: 22.5 G.5A – Reserves of depository institutions, Federal Reserve Bank credit and related items, 1984‑2023 and month‑end 2023
sub_nodes.summary: Year‑end and month‑end figures for reserve‑fund sources and uses, including Federal Reserve credit and securities holdings.

sub_nodes.title: 22.6 G.5B – Reserves of depository institutions, Federal Reserve Bank credit and related items, 1918‑1983
sub_nodes.summary: Historical series of reserve‑fund factors for 1918‑1983, detailing credit, securities and other components.

sub_nodes.title: 22.7 G.6 – Principal assets and liabilities of insured commercial banks, June 30 2023 and 2022
sub_nodes.summary: Snapshot of assets, liabilities and equity of U.S. insured commercial banks for mid‑2023 and 2022 by bank class.

sub_nodes.title: 22.8 G.7 – Initial margin requirements under Regulations T, U, and X
sub_nodes.summary: Historical percentages of market value required as margin for short sales and convertible bonds under the three regulations.

sub_nodes.title: 22.9 G.8A – Statement of condition of the Federal Reserve Banks, December 31 2023 and 2022
sub_nodes.summary: Balance‑sheet items for each Reserve Bank, including assets, loans, securities and equity for the end of 2023 and 2022.

sub_nodes.title: 22.10 Table G.8A—continued (Liabilities and capital accounts by district)
sub_nodes.summary: Continues detailed balance‑sheet items for Boston, New York, Philadelphia, Cleveland and Richmond, including liabilities and capital accounts for 2023 and 2022.

sub_nodes.title: 22.11 Table G.8A – Statement of condition of the Federal Reserve Banks, by Bank (December 31, 2023 and 2022)
sub_nodes.summary: Presents assets, liabilities and capital for each Federal Reserve Bank (Atlanta, Chicago, St. Louis, Minneapolis, Kansas City, Dallas, San Francisco) for 2023 and 2022.

sub_nodes.title: 22.12 Table G.8B – Statement of condition of the Federal Reserve Banks, December 31, 2023 and 2022 (aggregate)
sub_nodes.summary: Aggregated totals of Federal Reserve notes, collateral, Treasury securities and other items for the System as of the end of 2023 and 2022.

sub_nodes.title: 22.13 Table G.9 – Income and expenses of the Federal Reserve Banks, by Bank, 2023 (selected districts)
sub_nodes.summary: Shows detailed current income, operating expenses and net income for each Reserve Bank (Boston, New York, Philadelphia, Cleveland, Richmond) for 2023.

sub_nodes.title: 22.14 Table G.9 – Income and expenses of the Federal Reserve Banks, by Bank, 2023 (regional banks)
sub_nodes.summary: Provides the same income‑expense breakdown for the regional Reserve Banks (Atlanta, Chicago, St. Louis, Minneapolis, Kansas City, Dallas, San Francisco).

sub_nodes.title: 22.15 Table G.10 – Income and expenses of the Federal Reserve Banks, 1914–2023
sub_nodes.summary: Historical series of assessments, net income, expenses and other financial components for the System from 1914 through 2023, including totals by bank.

sub_nodes.title: 22.16 Table G.11 – Operations in principal departments of the Federal Reserve Banks, 2020–2023
sub_nodes.summary: Counts of currency pieces processed, checks, securities and funds transfers, and corresponding dollar values for the System from 2020 to 2023.

sub_nodes.title: 22.17 Table G.12 – Number and annual salaries of officers and employees of the Federal Reserve Banks, December 31, 2023
sub_nodes.summary: Lists the number of officers, other staff and total employees, along with annual salary totals for each Reserve Bank and the IT unit.

sub_nodes.title: 22.18 Table G.13 – Acquisition costs and net book value of the premises of the Federal Reserve Banks and Branches, December 31, 2023
sub_nodes.summary: Summarizes land, building and total acquisition costs and net book values for each Reserve Bank and its branches.
